244:  * ----------------------------------------
245:  * Reads BCDB_BLOCK_RETURN_ACTUAL_RESULTS and caches the result.
246:  *
247:  * The deterministic block-submit path defaults to returning a "completion
248:  * receipt" (tx hash + newline) per tx rather than the full row payload.  The
249:  * post-run Merkle gate is what verifies state correctness across replicas;
250:  * the per-tx row text returned to the frontend can otherwise reflect local
251:  * worker timing on reads.  Setting this env var to a truthy value reinstates
252:  * the full hex-encoded payload for diagnostics.
253:  */
254: static bool
255: bcdb_block_return_actual_results_enabled(void)
256: {
257: 	static int enabled = -1;
258:

265: 				   strcmp(v, "false") != 0 &&

267: 				   strcmp(v, "no") != 0 &&
